feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 November 2026 9:30pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 25 November 2026 at 9:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing. Risk of gales later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over Scandinavia extends a ridge across the Irish Sea today. Atlantic fronts then arrive later tomorrow.


##Wind##

East or Southeast 4 or 5, veering and increasing South or Southeast 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, increasing 6 or 7 occasionally gale 8 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain spreading from the west later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southeast 6 or 7 occasionally gale 8 at first, veering and decreasing West 3 or 4 in west of area late in night. Becoming Variable 2 to 4 in most waters on Friday morning, but still Southeast 5 or 6 in east. Settling southeast 2 to 4 in all waters later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate on Friday afternoon, then slight in the evening.


##Weather##

Rain spreading from the west, becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
